cohort: Women who received care for pregnancy and childbirth at a single academic maternity unit in the Netherlands between 2018 and 2019.
finding: The use of Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) and Patient-reported experience measures (PREMs) in pregnancy and childbirth care provides new insights into quality of care, identifying actionable targets for improvement not typically found with standard clinical quality indicators.
mod_finding: Women undergoing vaginal assisted delivery had a higher likelihood of experiencing pain with sexual intercourse (OR 2.2).
